what: On the panel, whenever the cursor moves more than 28px after 45ms, one card (character or photo) is placed at the cursor spot at .45x, transparent, at ±6.5°. It pops out to 1x and .95 opacity in .22s back.out(1.4), then .1s later slides down 25~45px over .6s power2.in, shrinking to .8x and vanishing. Each card is picked at random from the set, always different from the one just before — swinging the cursor makes a tail of cards that forms and melts away.

options.every · gap: New card gap — time (ms) · distance (px), default 45 · 28
options.tilt: Tilt width (deg) — half of it when placed, default 26
options.pop · drop · wait: Pop-out and drip-down durations, pause between (sec), default .22 · .6 · .1
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Card set for the tail (required) — hidden and cloned. Size, corners, and shadow follow the user’s css
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: (If present) the panel to float cards on — otherwise the panel itself
